description: Saves finished Film scenes, visualWorld, camera directions and dialogue against the current revision. Scenes form 30-second cards, with at most six spoken lines per card and five minutes per Film. Identical operationId/input retries return the saved result. visualWorld is required for quoting. No Brix36 planning model, media generation or credit charge. Each scene's sound comes from the scene's text unless stated. Music is included only when sound.music is true.

items.description: An available artist/actor in this Film’s workspace, in cast-slot order.

expectedRevisionId.description: The exact revisionId from studio_sections_read; null only for a Film with no storyboard.

language.description: The selected supported Film language; studio_film_read with include:['languages'] lists them. Text is preserved, never translated.

operationId.description: Stable operation identifier. Identical retries retain the original identifier; new work has a distinct identifier.

projectId.description: A project created by studio_video_start with kind film.

items.description: Shape: {what: string, camera: string, lines?: list of {speakerId: string, parenthetical: string, text: string, onCamera: boolean, useCharacterVoice?: boolean, voiceDescription?: string}, sound?: {music?: boolean, effects?: boolean, background?: boolean}}

visualWorld.description: Board-wide visual facts. Optional characters, vehicles, locations, props and never are arrays of up to 12 non-empty strings, each at most 300 characters. Combined rendered fields are limited to 2,400 characters including labels, separators and newlines after trimming. Scene-specific costume and visual direction belong to scene text.
